principles: Repository preservation and public distribution are separate.
A capability may remain in source history while being excluded from the public plugin payload.
Do not rename or disguise an out-of-scope healthcare workflow to bypass review.
Distribution eligibility must be machine-checked before packaging.

review_rule: A pattern match is not automatic rejection, but any matched public-bundle skill requires an explicit distribution decision before packaging.
